1.consolidated_definition: Afectar, impresionar, chocar. Desconcertar a causa de un acontecimiento o noticia. Se usa frecuentemente en sustitución de verbos tradicionales: afectar, impresionar, dominar, chocar, golpear, etc. Usual. DRAE: desde 1984. Los suicidios de comunistas, incluyendo líderes y familiares de éstos, impactan a la opinión popular aunque siempre bajo un manto de silencio y secreto ()
1.en_consolidated_definition: To affect, impress, or shock. To be disconcerted by an event or news. Frequently used in place of traditional verbs such as to affect, impress, dominate, shock, strike, etc. Usual. (First recorded in the DRAE since 1984.) The suicides of communists, including leaders and their relatives, impact public opinion although always under a veil of silence and secrecy.
